title: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now

entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A young Temur hunter who nearly kills her twin under Bolas's influence, then resists him and hides in the hedron during the confrontation.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A young whisperer who wears Naiva's mantle to deceive Bolas and protects herself and Yasova with earth magic.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The former Temur chief who confesses she helped Bolas against Ugin, then outwits Bolas with a bluff about Ugin's trap.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon and planeswalker who killed Ugin and returns to Tarkir to finish him, but is tricked into fleeing.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon, a planeswalker whose memories are recounted: he is hunted by Bolas across the planes, killed in the Meditation Realm, and later devises a plan with an ally to trap Bolas on Tarkir.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A young Jeskai ghostfire warrior who rushes to Naiva's side and agrees to stay for some months to recite Ugin's story.

entities.name: Fec
entities.description: An orc who carves scrimshaw records for the hidden collection.

entities.name: Mattak
entities.description: A hunter of the party.

entities.name: Oiyan
entities.description: A hunter of the party.

entities.name: Rakhan
entities.description: A hunter of the party.

entities.name: Sorya
entities.description: A hunter of the party.

entities.name: Te Ju Ki
entities.description: The human elder whose words about death calm Ugin.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: A dragon whose example Ugin recalls.

entities.name: Ugin's ally
aliases: winged creature with a man's bearded face and a big cat's paws
entities.description: A winged sphinx-like creature in a city of glass and stone who agrees to help Ugin trap Bolas.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The Dragonlord who the Temur must keep believing she has killed all the whisperers.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A Dragonlord whose broodlings hunt ghostfire warriors.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Rock cocoons that hold Ugin's essence and shield those inside from Bolas's mind touch.

entities.name: The Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact that was part of Ugin's plan to trap Bolas; Yasova bluffs that it is aimed at Bolas on Tarkir.

entities.name: The Meditation Realm
entities.description: A still-water realm between planes where Ugin meditated and where Bolas killed him.

entities.name: Ugin's grave
entities.description: The canyon of hedrons holding Ugin's bones.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Ugin's soul's home, which Bolas threatens to destroy.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of Ugin and Bolas's birth.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: An island chain on Dominaria where Bolas falls after Ugin's death.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A storm-wracked plane Ugin flees to.

entities.name: Kephalai
entities.description: A plane Ugin flees through.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane Ugin flees through.

entities.name: Whisper Mind
entities.description: The mind-to-mind skill of the whisperers, taught by Ugin to the ancestors.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Temur shamans hidden from Atarka.

entities.name: The Temur
entities.description: Yasova's clan that must survive and preserve its memories.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: Tae Jin's people.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: The ruling dragons who mean to obliterate knowledge of the past.

events.summary: Naiva, her mind twisted by Bolas, holds a knife to Baishya's throat, then snaps out of it as the hedron's essence reaches her and Yasova disarms her.
events.quote: Why was she holding a blade against her sister's throat?

events.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas killed Ugin and uses mind touch, and that she will be taken because he threatened Tarkir.
events.quote: The dragon who killed Ugin has returned.

events.summary: Yasova confesses she helped Bolas track Ugin and cast a spell that turned fledgling dragons against him, after being promised an end to dragons.
events.quote: I helped Bolas track down Ugin because he promised me an end to dragons on Tarkir.

events.summary: Yasova argues that destroying the hedrons would destroy Ugin's essence, the soul of Tarkir, so they must resist Bolas.
events.quote: I do not believe Bolas can destroy the hedrons.

events.summary: Naiva takes Baishya's hand and enters Ugin's memories in the Meditation Realm.
events.quote: After a decisive nod at Grandmother, she took hold of Baishya's hand.

events.summary: Memory: Ugin, in the Meditation Realm, regrets that Nicol was not overjoyed at his return and wonders whether his departure was his fault.
events.quote: Nicol had succumbed to the worst in himself

events.summary: Memory: Bolas attacks Ugin in the Meditation Realm, accusing him of hoarding the planes' knowledge and abandoning him.
events.quote: You hoarded the knowledge of the planes to yourself.

events.summary: Memory: Ugin flees through Zendikar, Kephalai and Ravnica with Bolas in pursuit, wounded by his venomous magic.
events.quote: From bustling Kephalai to growing Ravnica and on and on, he flees with Nicol breathing down his neck

events.summary: Memory: Ugin realizes Nicol will never stop unless he thinks him dead, and accepts death in the Meditation Realm.
events.quote: With a sigh, Ugin accepts his death. He lets go.

events.summary: Memory: Bolas kills Ugin, who falls into the waters; the cataclysm drains the realm and flings Bolas to Madara.
events.quote: With a mighty splash, Ugin falls into the still waters.

events.summary: Memory: The realm refills and a dragon, reborn from the waters, resolves to protect the planes and departs.
events.quote: Ugin has a lot to do if he means to protect the planes.

events.summary: Memory: Bolas, as god-emperor, sets two curved horns over the Meditation Realm to mark his triumph.
events.quote: Here, he erects two gigantic curved horns so they emerge from the waters

events.summary: Memory: Ugin asks a winged ally in a glass city for help to trap Bolas, planning to lure him to Tarkir.
events.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

events.summary: Memory: Bolas arrives on Tarkir and, turning the dragons against their progenitor, kills Ugin, who falls and carves the canyon.
events.quote: Bolas turns the dragons of Tarkir against their own progenitor

events.summary: Naiva and Baishya wake from the memories and tell Yasova what they saw; Yasova decides to surrender herself to Bolas as a desperate gamble.
events.quote: The Spirit Dragon has not forgotten Tarkir. We have a chance to deflect Bolas.

events.summary: Yasova has Baishya wear Naiva's mantle and necklace to meet Bolas in Naiva's place.
events.quote: Baishya will wear your mantle and go out in your place.

events.summary: Yasova and Baishya face Bolas, taunting him that he came back to confirm Ugin was dead.
events.quote: You came back to see if he was really dead.

events.summary: Bolas threatens to devastate Tarkir and orders Naiva to kill Yasova, but Naiva resists in the hedron.
events.quote: Do it, Naiva. I command you! Kill her, and I will grant you all that you desire

events.summary: Yasova tells Bolas that the Immortal Sun will trap him and Baishya says they hear the artifact; Bolas, fearing the bluff may be true, strikes the canyon and flees.
events.quote: The Immortal Sun is pointed here, at this very spot on Tarkir.

events.summary: Naiva emerges to find the dragon gone and discovers Yasova and Baishya alive, shielded by Baishya's earth magic.
events.quote: A big boulder shifted with a great, grinding rumble.

events.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
events.quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: The rest of the party arrives; Tae Jin tells Naiva he would never mistake her for her sister again.
events.quote: I wouldn't mistake you for your sister ever again.

events.summary: Yasova tells the girls they must safeguard memory and asks Tae Jin to stay to recite Ugin's story to Fec for carving.
events.quote: I would like you to recite Ugin's story once again to Fec so it can be carved and preserved in more than one place.

events.summary: Yasova closes by telling the girls that even the greatest of dragons can die and that anything may come to pass in the unwritten now.
events.quote: Even the greatest of dragons can die.

relations.note: Bolas killed Ugin on Tarkir by turning the dragons against him, and earlier in the Meditation Realm
relations.quote: He killed Ugin by turning the minds of all the dragons against their own progenitor.
The brother he was born with, whom he flew with—Nicol—has been entirely devoured by Bolas

relations.note: Yasova helped Bolas track Ugin years ago, deceived by his promise; now opposes him
relations.quote: To my shame, I even cast a spell that helped him turn the minds of the fledgling dragons against Ugin.
She smiled at her sister's face, twin to her own, the mirror she'd looked into for all of her life.

relations.note: grandmother; delivered the twins from her dead daughter
relations.quote: I cut you two out of my daughter's dead body with the knife you were holding to your sister's throat.

relations.note: the winged ally agrees to help trap Bolas
relations.quote: Ugin, my friend, welcome to my newest home.

relations.note: Ugin taught the skill of the Whisper Mind to ancestral shamans
relations.quote: He taught the skill to the shamans among our ancestors.
with an intent gaze that made her flush warmly

relations.note: Atarka must believe she has killed all whisperers
relations.quote: Above all else, she must believe she has killed all the whisperers.

relations.note: carves records for her hidden collection
relations.quote: one that would be added to the scrimshaw collection hidden in the caves

relations.note: her words about death guide him
relations.quote: My essence will continue to exist in other forms. All things end. Sometimes that is not the same as dying.
